name: Tengoku Hime 2 ~Haken Soudatsu, Gen'you no Shousei~
original_name: 天極姫2~覇権争奪, 幻妖の将星~
source:
Another crossover work featuring heroines from Sengoku Hime VI and Sangoku Hime IV with original story and new heroes.

Everyone lives happily in the paradise Venard, where there is no fighting nor starvation. Generation after generation, the king governs the paradise by following the divine messages in the ‘Book of Prophecies’. However, one day these messages stopped appearing and strange beings appeared from a distortion in the space-time continuum. With strife breaking out in various areas, the king decided to use a secret art which had been passed down the Imperial family. In exchange for his life, the new rulers would be summoned to govern Venard. With that, he disappeared without a trace. What will become of this world?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是另一部联合作品，汇集《战国姬VI》和《三国姬IV》的女主角，采用原创故事并加入新英雄。

所有人都幸福地生活在没有战争与饥饿的天堂维纳德。国王世代遵循“预言之书”的神谕统治天堂。然而，某天神谕停止出现，奇怪生物从时空连续体的扭曲中现身。各地冲突四起，国王决定使用皇室世代相传的秘术。以牺牲自己的生命为代价，新的统治者将被召唤来管理维纳德。随后，他消失得无影无踪。这个世界将走向何方？

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
